name: Magna Seal

features.text: Two liquid ounces can do an entire car.
Dries very quickly and is easily removed without streaks, leaving an outstanding gloss and protection.

description: A water-thin, one-step liquid wax. It is off-white in color and must be shaken before use, as it will separate on standing. Magna Seal TM has a slight solvent odor. This product can be used on clearcoat and conventional paints, as a one-step liquid wax, to clean, polish and protect.
application: Saturate an applicator pad and squeeze out excess. Apply by hand in an overlapping, circular motion. Allow to dry. Wipe off with a clean cloth. Can be removed with an orbital buffer after hand application.
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Abrasiveness - 2 Gloss - 8 Durability - 6
